title: Complex product expansion
statement:
Let $n$ be a natural number and let $x=(x_0,\ldots,x_{n-1})\in\{−1,1\}^n$. For each subset $S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, write $m_S(x)=\prod_{i\in S}x_i$. Then
\[\prod_{i=0}^{n-1}\left(-\frac12+\frac{\sqrt3}{2}x_i\,i\right)=\left(-\frac12\right)^n\sum_{S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}}(-\sqrt3)^{|S|}m_S(x)\,i^{|S|},\]
where $i=\sqrt{-1}$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is an $n$-tuple with each coordinate in $\{−1,1\}$
